name: Aarav Marfatia
achievements: 1430 on the PSAT 8/9, a 4.0 GPA, and A's in all classes.
bio:
I am a 9th grader in the Wheeler Magnet program who loves to do robotics and coding. Outside of the classroom I play both the piano and the cello, so I know what it feels like to practice something over and over until it finally clicks. Working through a tricky problem and seeing it come together is one of my favorite feelings, and I like helping other people get to that same moment.

When I am tutoring, my goal is to make the material feel a lot less intimidating. I try to explain things in more than one way until it makes sense, and I never want anyone to feel embarrassed for asking a question. Come as you are, bring whatever you are stuck on, and we will figure it out together.

name: Adhidev Nithyanadan
achievements: 1360 on the PSAT 8/9, a 4.0 GPA, and A's in all classes.
bio:
I am a 9th grader in the Wheeler Magnet program with a true passion for cricket, math and science. I love the outdoors and any form of learning new things. I believe that everyone deserves the opportunity to learn in the way that suits themselves best, which is why I co-founded wheeler magnet tutoring.

 If/when we work together, I will be happy to explain concepts in a way that you really understand, rather than forcing you to memorize random facts. Make sure to bring a pencil, your homework, any other basic/neccessary materials--and your ready to learn attitude! Thank you for supporting our student-led initiative and we look forward for you to become a loyal client.

name: Adam Ozon
bio:
I am a 9th grader in the Wheeler Magnet program, and Spanish is the subject I love helping with most. Learning a language can feel overwhelming at first, with all the new vocabulary and verb endings, but I have found that it clicks once you stop trying to memorize everything at once and start using it a little at a time. I like making that process feel a lot less stressful.

When we work together, I will go at your pace and explain things in plain terms, whether you are just starting Spanish 1 or working through the subjunctive in Spanish 4. Bring your assignment or whatever you are stuck on, and we will practice it together until it feels natural.

name: Ethan Torres
achievements: Member of the Math Team and Science Olympiad.
bio:
I am a 9th grader in the Wheeler Magnet program, and I'm part of the Math Team and Science Olympiad. Geometry is my favorite subject — I love how it turns tricky ideas into something you can actually picture and work through. When I'm not studying, you'll usually find me playing games or walking my dog.

I enjoy helping other people get past the moment where a problem feels impossible, because I know how good it feels when it finally clicks. Bring whatever you're stuck on and we'll work through it together, one step at a time.

name: Mateus Aguiar
achievements: 1270 on the PSAT 8/9, Simpson Math Bee winner, a 4.0 GPA, and A's in all classes.
bio:
I am a freshman in the Wheeler Magnet program. Outside of class I like to play the piano, watch physics documentaries, walk my dog, and build and create new things. That curiosity about how things work is exactly what I bring to tutoring, because I love breaking a problem down until it finally makes sense.

When we work together, I will be patient and meet you at your level, no matter how stuck you feel at the start. My goal is for you to walk away not just with the answer, but with a real understanding of how to get there on your own next time. Bring whatever you are working on and we will take it one step at a time.

name: Ryan Tran
bio:
I am a student in the Wheeler Magnet program and the physical science tutor here at Magnet Tutoring. I'm Vietnamese, and I've always loved taking things apart to see how they work — that curiosity is what pulled me into physics and chemistry.

When we work together, I'll break big ideas into small, clear steps and connect them to things you can picture. Bring whatever you're stuck on and we'll work through it together until it makes sense.
